summarize_language_code_to_name: summarize the language_code_to_name dict mapping ISO codes to language names
create_language_code_lookup: create a reverse lookup from language name to ISO code using LANGUAGE_NAME_TO_CODE
summarize_text_source_languages: summarize the text_source_language_codes list used for T2TT and T2ST source languages
summarize_s2st_target_languages: summarize the s2st_target_language_codes list used for speech-to-text and text-to-text target languages
summarize_target_language_names: summarize the S2TT, T2TT, and ASR target language name lists derived from TEXT_SOURCE_LANGUAGE_NAMES
